name: nginx-multisite
description: Installs and configures Nginx for three SSL-enabled sites, including virtual hosts, TLS, security headers, static content, Fail2ban, firewall rules, sysctl settings, and SSH hardening.

name: cache
description: Provisions Memcached and Redis caching services, including a password-protected Redis instance with service and configuration management.

name: fastapi-tutorial
description: Installs and runs a FastAPI tutorial application with Python, a local PostgreSQL database, a virtual environment, dependencies, and a systemd service.
